metadata.title: INCREDIBLE Food of Bihar + Himachal + Assam + Haryana | Community & Food Stories (Regional) Season 2
metadata.description:
► Subscribe to Delhi Food Walks: 
https://www.youtube.com/user/Delhifoodwalks

From ancient times, Delhi has been a melting pot of cultures and cuisines. People from different states and regions in India have settled here and made it their home. And if you want to experience the regional flavours, then the best place is the homes of people from respective communities.

Propelled by the curiosity to discover these flavours, in recent times, there has been a surge of home chefs and delivery kitchens serving food from their respective homelands.

So in the second season of 'Community & Food Stories' of Delhi series we are on a quest to explore these soulful flavours hidden in the kitchens of some of Delhi's regional communities like Haryanvi, Himachali, Assamese and Bihari. It is an effort to discover the capital's wondrous syncretic temperament through the lens of food. We had filmed it last year when the pandemic was on decline.

So get ready for this enriching and drooling journey that starts on 29th May 2021.

About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://www.instagram.com/anubhav.sapra/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 
 
Thank you for watching! 
 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks 
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks
 
Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2/
